input.task: Navigate to the product page and tell me its title.

provenance: the twin of nav-load-event-never-fires, and the reason it exists is a review note rather than a run: `run_task` has **two** `page.goto` calls — the pre-plan navigation and the `navigate` action inside `execute()` — and the first case only exercises the first. Fixing one goto would have turned that case green with half the defect still live, on the path any multi-page plan actually uses. An eval that can pass while the bug survives is worth less than no eval, because it also stops anyone looking.

triage.watched_red: written and run before either goto was touched: failure:nav on the pre-plan hop. Re-watched after fixing only the pre-plan goto, which is the state that matters — it stayed red, failing on the `navigate` STEP at 20s, which is exactly what this case was written to catch.
triage.postcondition: `text_visible: LAMP-SLOW` rather than a URL check: the point is that the page is READABLE after the hop, not merely that goto returned. A navigate whose wait condition is satisfied but whose content is not there would pass a `url_contains` and fail this.
